description: This file defines the WPTManifest class responsible for handling and processing the MANIFEST.json file related to web-platform-tests, including functions for parsing, checking test files, extracting references, and generating manifests.

classes.name: WPTManifest
classes.description: Class responsible for managing and parsing the web-platform-tests manifest JSON, including methods for retrieving items, checking test files, extracting references, and generating manifests.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the WPTManifest object by loading JSON content into a dictionary.

methods.name: _items_for_path
methods.description: Retrieves manifest items for a given WPT path, returning None if not found.

methods.name: is_test_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path corresponds to a test file in the manifest.

methods.name: file_path_to_url_paths
methods.description: Converts a file path in WPT to URL paths based on manifest data.

methods.name: _get_extras_from_item
methods.description: Extracts the extras dictionary from a manifest item.

methods.name: is_slow_test
methods.description: Determines if a test is marked as slow based on its extras.

methods.name: extract_reference_list
methods.description: Extracts reference test information for a given test path.

methods.name: ensure_manifest
methods.description: Ensures the manifest exists, creating it if necessary, using the host filesystem.

methods.name: generate_manifest
methods.description: Generates the MANIFEST.json file in a specified directory.
